projectDescription: Horion is a Minecraft: Bedrock Edition utility mod that injects as a DLL to provide gameplay enhancements through a module system, in-game commands, and a JavaScript scripting API.
keyFeatures: 60+ gameplay modules across Combat, Visual, Movement, Player, World, and Misc categories
In-game command system with 30+ commands triggered by a configurable prefix
JavaScript scripting engine (powered by Chakra) for custom module and command creation
JSON-based config manager for saving and loading module settings
Click GUI for interactive module toggling and settings adjustment
Friend list system for team-aware modules
DLL injection into Minecraft: Bedrock Edition on Windows
ESP overlays, radar, waypoints, and other visual aids
Movement hacks: Fly, Speed, Bhop, Phase, NoFall, Spider, and more
Combat modules: Aimbot, KillAura, CrystalAura, AutoClicker, TriggerBot
publicApiSurface: IModule (base class: onTick, onEnable, onDisable, onPreRender, onPostRender, onMove, onSendPacket, onAttack, onKeyUpdate)
IMCCommand (base class: execute, getCommand, getDescription, getUsage)
JS API: localPlayer.setPosition(), setVelocity(), setViewAngles(), getInventory()
JS API: entity.getPosition(), getVelocity(), isOnGround(), getViewAngles()
JS API: drawUtils.drawLine3d(), drawLine2d(), drawRectangle2d(), drawText2d(), setColor()
JS API: inventory.getItems(), getArmor(), getHeld(), getSlot(), moveItem(), setSelected()
Module categories: COMBAT, VISUAL, MOVEMENT, PLAYER, WORLD, MISC, CUSTOM
SettingEntry types: Float, Int, Bool, Enum, Text
